newsitem.title: UK: Smith & Nephew weak after warning.
newsitem.headline: Smith & Nephew weak after warning.

text.p: Shares in Smith & Nephew Plc weakened on Monday after the UK healthcare group warned operating conditions remained difficult.
Smith & Nephew shares, ex a 2.86p gross dividend, were down 4-3/4p at 211-1/2p by 1430 GMT in an otherwise steady market. Almost 15 million shares had changed hands by that time.
"The share went ex-dividend today and we've had a big seller in the market. The company's statement was less than bullish and it was as good a time as any to book profits," one dealer said.
Smith & Nephew shares have risen by more than 13 percent since the start of the year.

The company said earlier on Monday that overall group sales growth continued in line with half-year results, although operating conditions remained difficult. It warned price pressure was tightening in the U.S.
In August, Smith & Nephew posted first-half turnover of 540 million stg, up from 503 million stg in the year-earlier period.
